data.desc: Mount Logan Capital Inc. ('MLCI') is an integrated alternative asset management and insurance solutions firm focused on generating durable, fee-based revenue and long-term value creation. MLCI leverages differentiated investment strategies alongside permanent insurance capital to deliver attractive, risk-adjusted returns across market cycles. Through its subsidiaries, MLM and Ability Insurance Company, MLCI manages and invests across private and public credit markets in North America and operates an insurance platform that provides long-duration liabilities to support its credit investment strategies. This integrated platform is designed to provide stable earnings, downside protection, and a low risk of principal impairment through the credit cycle. As of June 30, 2026, MLCI had over $2 billion in assets under management.
